title: ofetch
description: A better Fetch API with composable helpers.

data.text: ofetch is a lightweight fetch wrapper with sensible defaults and composable utilities.

data.title: ofetch with base URL

data.text: `ofetch` parses JSON automatically, throws on non-2xx responses, and integrates with Nuxt so requests are made on the server during SSR and on the client afterwards. In Nuxt the `$fetch` helper uses it and carries cookies and base URL from the runtime config.

data.title: ofetch client and Nuxt $fetch

data.text: `onRequest`, `onRequestError`, `onResponse`, and `onResponseError` provide the interception points. Errors are `FetchError` instances with a parsed `data` property, so the server error body is available without an extra parse. Retries are configured per call or on the client.

data.title: Retry and handle a typed error body
SSR is the reason to pick it
data.text: ofetch exists because Nuxt needs one fetch API that works on the server and the client with the same relative URLs and cookie forwarding. If you are not using Nuxt, plain `fetch` plus a small helper covers the same ground. Say that rather than presenting it as universally better.

terms.definition: Can be combined with other utilities.
